blocks.html: 1Why we learn fixed words now

src.text: Why we learn fixed words now

blocks.html: Fixed words are in almost every sentence. Pronouns, words like هَذَا, and question words come again and again.

src.text: Fixed words are in almost every sentence. Pronouns, words like {هَذَا}, and question words come again and again.

blocks.html: Their ending never changes. So you learn each one once, as a word in a table, and you know it for good.

src.text: Their ending never changes. So you learn each one once, as a word in a table, and you know it for good.

blocks.html: When you know them, every later example is easier. You see the fixed words at once and look only at the flexible ones.

blocks.html: Tip: Side note: each pronoun is built on one fixed mark. هُوَ is built on fatha, نَحْنُ on damma, هُمْ on sukūn. You do not need to learn these. Just remember the word never changes.

Tip: هُوَ and هِيَ are also used for things. A masculine noun is هُوَ, a feminine noun is هِيَ: أَيْنَ السَّاعَةُ؟ هِيَ عَلَى السَّرِيرِ.

src.text: {هُوَ} and {هِيَ} are also used for things. A masculine noun is {هُوَ}, a feminine noun is {هِيَ}: {أَيْنَ السَّاعَةُ؟ هِيَ عَلَى السَّرِيرِ}.

blocks.html: Tip: For two people, men or women, there is one word: أَنْتُمَا or هُمَا. For a group of men and women together, use أَنْتُمْ and هُمْ.

blocks.html: 5A fixed word still has a job

src.text: A fixed word still has a job

blocks.html: A pronoun never changes its last vowel to show rafʿ, naṣb or jarr. But it still does a job in the sentence, like any noun.

src.text: A pronoun never changes its last vowel to show rafʿ, naṣb or jarr. But it still does a job in the sentence, like any noun.

blocks.html: The place of rafʿ. In هُوَ طَالِبٌ, هُوَ is the Topic. A Topic is rafʿ. هُوَ cannot show a damma, so we say it is in the place of rafʿ: فِي مَحَلِّ رَفْعٍ.

src.title: The place of rafʿ
src.text: In {هُوَ طَالِبٌ}, {هُوَ} is the Topic. A Topic is rafʿ. {هُوَ} cannot show a damma, so we say it is in the place of rafʿ: {فِي مَحَلِّ رَفْعٍ}.

blocks.html: So we describe a fixed word in two steps: first its job, then its place.

src.text: So we describe a fixed word in two steps: first its job, then its place.

blocks.html:
WordJobEndingRafʿ, naṣb or jarr
هُوَTopicfixed, never changesin the place of rafʿ
طَالِبٌInformationdamma, you can see itrafʿ
Tip: There are three places: فِي مَحَلِّ رَفْعٍ، فِي مَحَلِّ نَصْبٍ، فِي مَحَلِّ جَرٍّ. In this stage, these twelve pronouns are always in the place of rafʿ.

blocks.html: 6Sentences with a pronoun

src.text: Sentences with a pronoun

blocks.html: Here the pronoun is the Topic. The Information is a noun or a place phrase.

src.text: Here the pronoun is the Topic. The Information is a noun or a place phrase.

blocks.html:
أَنَا طَالِبٌ.
I am a student.
أَنَا is the Topic, in the place of rafʿ. طَالِبٌ is the Information, rafʿ with damma.
هِيَ مُدَرِّسَةٌ.
She is a teacher.
هِيَ is the Topic, in the place of rafʿ.
نَحْنُ فِي الفَصْلِ.
We are in the classroom.
نَحْنُ is the Topic. الفَصْلِ is jarr after فِي.
هُمْ فِي المَسْجِدِ.
They are in the mosque.
هُمْ is the Topic, in the place of rafʿ.
أَنْتُمَا فِي البَيْتِ.
You two are in the house.
أَنْتُمَا is the Topic, in the place of rafʿ.
أَيْنَ الوَلَدُ؟ هُوَ فِي المَسْجِدِ.
Where is the boy? He is in the mosque.
Madinah lesson 4. هُوَ takes the place of الوَلَدُ.

items.note: {أَنَا} is the Topic, in the place of rafʿ. {طَالِبٌ} is the Information, rafʿ with damma.
{هِيَ} is the Topic, in the place of rafʿ.
{نَحْنُ} is the Topic. {الفَصْلِ} is jarr after {فِي}.
{هُمْ} is the Topic, in the place of rafʿ.

blocks.html: Tip: A pronoun can replace a noun: الطَّالِبُ فِي الفَصْلِ becomes هُوَ فِي الفَصْلِ. Pick the pronoun by number and gender.

src.text: A pronoun can replace a noun: {الطَّالِبُ فِي الفَصْلِ} becomes {هُوَ فِي الفَصْلِ}. Pick the pronoun by number and gender.

blocks.html:
In short

  1. Fixed words are in every sentence. Learn them once, as a table.
  2. There are twelve separate pronouns: أَنَا، نَحْنُ، أَنْتَ، أَنْتِ، أَنْتُمَا، أَنْتُمْ، أَنْتُنَّ، هُوَ، هِيَ، هُمَا، هُمْ، هُنَّ.
  3. Choose by person (speaker, listener, absent), number (one, two, more) and gender.
  4. A pronoun never changes its ending, but it still has a job.
  5. As the Topic it is in the place of rafʿ: فِي مَحَلِّ رَفْعٍ.
